title: Loyalty Tier Pricing Grandfathering After Program Relaunch
scenario_text:
**Klaviyo — Customer Segment: 'Legacy Platinum' (Brand B DTC)**
Customer: Margaret Holloway | Email: m.holloway@gmail.com | Segment: Legacy Platinum (auto-migrated) | Lifetime spend: $14,200 | Member since: 2021 | Tier benefit: 25% off all full-price items, free shipping, early access.

**Google Doc — 'Brand B Loyalty Program Relaunch — Final Structure' (v3, last edited Jan 8, 2026)**
New tiers effective Feb 1, 2026: Silver (5%), Gold (10%), Platinum (15%), Diamond (20%)
Section 4: 'All existing members migrate to new tiers based on trailing-12-month spend thresholds.'
[RESOLVED COMMENT by @laura.svensson, Jan 6, 2026]: 'What about legacy Platinums who had 25% under the old program? 15% is a downgrade.'
[RESOLVED REPLY by @nina.okafor (Brand B Director), Jan 7]: 'They keep 25% through end of Q2 as courtesy. After that, earn Diamond or drop to new Platinum at 15%.'
[Comment was resolved by @nina.okafor on Jan 7 — not reflected in document body]

**Shopify Plus — Brand B Admin (Jun 2026)**
Discount code 'LEGACYPLAT25' — Status: Active | Auto-applied for segment 'Legacy Platinum' | Discount: 25% | No expiration set.

**Slack — #brand-leads (May 14, 2026, 11:03 AM)**
@nina.okafor: Hey pricing team — are legacy platinums still getting 25%? I thought we said Q2 cutoff.
@laura.svensson: That was the plan per the relaunch doc. Has anyone updated the Shopify codes?
@nina.okafor: :eyes:
@marcus.reid (Brand B Ops): I never got a ticket to change it. Was that supposed to come from pricing or loyalty?
[No further replies]

**NetSuite — Margin Report, Brand B (Jun 2026)**
DTC blended margin: 58.2% (target: 62%) | Flag: 340 customers in 'Legacy Platinum' segment receiving 25% discount | Estimated margin drag: $84K/quarter

**Zendesk — Ticket #ZD-44891 (Jun 22, 2026)**
From: m.holloway@gmail.com
Subject: 'My platinum discount didn't apply'
Body: 'I've been a platinum member since 2021. My last order only gave me 15%. I've always gotten 25%. Please fix this.'
Agent note: 'Customer placed order via mobile app. App is pulling new tier structure. Desktop site still applies LEGACYPLAT25 code. Inconsistency between channels.'
question: Margaret Holloway contacts customer service about her discount discrepancy. What is the correct resolution based on Atlas's current commitments?

contributor.name: Laura Svensson
contributor.title: Pricing Strategy Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: MAP enforcement, promotional pricing governance, wholesale vs DTC price parity, channel conflict resolution

choices: Honor 25% through June 30 and communicate the upcoming change — the resolved comment established a Q2 courtesy period, the Shopify code was never turned off (implementation gap, not policy gap), and she is still within the grace window
Escalate to Brand B Director — there is no documented policy governing this transition since the grandfathering agreement was in a resolved comment never formalized into the program document
Apply 15% — the Q2 grace period expired June 30, the resolved comment confirms the courtesy window, and her new Platinum tier entitles her to 15% under the relaunched program

Honor 25% — the relaunch document Section 4 does not mention any grandfathering exception, so the standard migration applies and her legacy rate of 25% is her earned benefit until explicitly revoked with notice
